properties.bedrock_lithology: Carboniferous basaltic volcanic rocks (Calton Hill lava sequence) and intrusive dolerite sill overlying Dinantian sandstones and siltstones
properties.drainage_profile: Steep fracture-controlled bedrock run-off down the Calton crag into the Waverley valley trough
properties.local_quarry_lithics: Craigleith and Hailes pale buff-to-blonde quartzose sandstone, dressed volcanic whinstone rubble

properties.primary_surfacing: Granite setts along Calton Road, high dressed sandstone retaining walls, weathered asphalt surfaces, stone copings
properties.micro_grading: Extreme elevation gradient dropping sharply from Waterloo Place down to Calton Road gorge
properties.wear_patina: Industrial atmospheric carbon soot crusting, damp moss growth along vertical bedrock cuts

properties.understory: Clinging ivy (Hedera helix), hardy cliffside grasses, and herbaceous burial ground turf

properties.typology: Georgian Neoclassical monumental civic architecture and stone infrastructure

structures.name: Regent Bridge & Waterloo Place Viaduct
structures.roof_geometry: Flat road deck with Neoclassical triumphal arch screen colonnades
structures.facade_material: Ashlar Craigleith sandstone with rusticated basement piers and Corinthian order screens
structures.weathering_patina: Two-century soot staining in recessed mouldings and arch undersides

structures.name: Calton Old Burial Ground & Hume Mausoleum
structures.roof_geometry: Cylindrical battlemented stone tower (David Hume Mausoleum) and gabled stone monuments
structures.facade_material: Dressed ashlar sandstone and carved headstones
structures.weathering_patina: Lichen-encrusted, deep oxidation and historic weathering

structures.name: Calton Road Perimeter Buildings
structures.roof_geometry: Mansard slate and flat membrane roofs
structures.facade_material: Blonde ashlar sandstone facade panels with vertical glazing inserts
structures.weathering_patina: Clean modern stone with subtle urban precipitation streaking

properties.lighting_condition: Golden hour raking sunlight piercing low-altitude urban mist and haar
properties.visibility: Atmospheric haze with high local contrast in direct sunlight
